observable_photo_form.observation: The relatedBM150 central casting is physically bare on one lateral side: a deep broad circular cavity at image left and a smaller angular bearing/boss field at right, with multiple real openings and a continuous irregular peripheral rim.
Raised ribs connect the main central opening, smaller round seats, peripheral bolt stations and lower body; rib sections vary and join round bosses, rather than uniform decorative straight bars.
Several small windows/apertures and machined-looking bright bearing lands contrast with grey cast-looking walls. The photo does not calibrate metal alloy, finish, roughness or machining tolerance.

A substantial lower horizontal ledge/body, a large threaded-looking lower-left boss, a smaller low centre seat and a lower-right mounting ear are visible. This is a partial lateral view of the base, not an orthogonal underside view.
Characters JE541039 are visually readable on the casting. Their role is unknown: they do not replace the sellerSKU36PF0004 or certify interchangeability/year.

cross_part_interface_rules: The central block is two asymmetric physical castings. Do not bridge the three existing outer covers with a generic solid envelope.
A mounted outer-cover silhouette does not establish the central-half mating plane or the full bare underside.
Cylinder foot, central crankcase halves, outer covers, strainer cap, filter cap and kick mechanisms keep separate owners/interfaces.
Bearing codes, oil-seal descriptions and M6bolt lengths in the catalogue describe those parts only; do not use them to certify central casing dimensions or depths.
One supplier photo and exploded diagrams do not establish currentRDC metric positions, the full count of hidden fasteners or geometric symmetry.
No detailed model, calibration, G3 fidelity or G8 user acceptance is supplied by this reference search.
